title: Run the frozen H114 multiradix carry/cohomology falsification panel
status_note: Producer, proof layer and independent verifier are published before data; the managed runtime has no checkpoint upload transport or digest-pinned EKS task image.

question: Does one unchanged predicate in the frozen 11,520-member H114 family give an exact scalar digit modulo 30 on all 28 rows and decode all 9,096 toy-curve targets?
decision_value: A nonempty independently verified 28-row exact-ID intersection advances the candidate to larger out-of-sample cohorts and a uniformity proof obligation; an empty intersection rejects this entire frozen shared-channel CRT family and redirects the next lead away from these first-layer windings.

resources.notes: The frozen execution deadline is 1,800 seconds and budget is USD 1.00. Integer-hour estimates round that ceiling upward; they are planning limits, not observed runtime. Zero scientific retries are allowed.

env.name: crypto-h114-multiradix
env.recipe: Build a UID-1000-compatible digest-pinned Isolab image from crypto producer revision 4ceb5c032917a5f72a15046eee5aa4aad327a93c and retain cryptanalysis verifier revision f18430232e2814922d95f67e97abdda5d6ff44f6 for independent output verification.

cairn.notes: Single exhaustive frozen run; not preemptible because the producer has no mid-run checkpoint. Do not replace it with quick mode or a local scoring run. Promotion to ready must copy/freeze the existing protocol in this card, pin merged source commits and bind a runnable independent verifier.

funding.rationale: Lower seed-card level: one bounded toy-cohort falsification with complete producer and verifier source, but no generic-speedup claim.
